content: LocalStack (and by extension similar emulators) is IAM-permissive by default -- it does not enforce IAM policies unless explicitly turned on, so code that lacks real IAM permissions can pass locally and fail in production. Athena in AWS runs on Trino/Presto engine with Hive DDL quirks; DuckDB is a different SQL dialect, so queries validated locally are not guaranteed syntax/semantics-identical to real Athena.
